<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script_include"><sys_ux_client_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><api_name>x_1529240_taskbudd.Fill_In</api_name><includes/><name>Fill_In</name><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[var TaskBuddClientScriptInclude = Class.create();
TaskBuddClientScriptInclude.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    
    // Diese Funktion wird vom UI Builder oder Client Script aufgerufen
    setPriorityColor: function(taskRecord) {
        // Prüfe den Wert von 'priority' und setze 'priority_color'
        if (taskRecord.priority == 'high') {
            taskRecord.priority_color = 'red';
        } else if (taskRecord.priority == 'medium') {
            taskRecord.priority_color = 'yellow';
        } else if (taskRecord.priority == 'low') {
            taskRecord.priority_color = 'green';
        } else {
            taskRecord.priority_color = 'gray';  // Standardfarbe, wenn keine Übereinstimmung
        }
        
        // Optional: Führe hier eine Log-Ausgabe durch, um das Ergebnis zu überprüfen
        gs.info('Priority Color for Task ' + taskRecord.sys_id + ': ' + taskRecord.priority_color);
        
        return taskRecord;  // Gib das aktualisierte Task-Objekt zurück
    },

    type: 'TaskBuddClientScriptInclude'
};
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-02-10 07:22:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>21133fbe83231210e9ef58a6feaad391</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Fill_In</sys_name><sys_package display_value="TaskBuddy" source="x_1529240_taskbudd">9ea39f5383321210e9ef58a6feaad3b7</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="TaskBuddy">9ea39f5383321210e9ef58a6feaad3b7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_include_21133fbe83231210e9ef58a6feaad391</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-02-10 07:34:17</sys_updated_on></sys_ux_client_script_include></record_update>
